name: circle-mcp
description: Circle (marketplaces): me, list_sales, list_refunds, refund. Every tool maps to a documented endpoin

platform_mcp_circle_admin_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CIRCLE_ADMIN_TOKEN
platform_mcp_circle_admin_token.description: Circle Admin API v2 token (community Settings > Developers > Tokens, type Admin V2; Business plan or above) sent as Authorization: Bearer per the Admin API quick start (the Swagger spec documents the same header as 'Token <token>').

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/admin/v2/community returns the community the token belongs to: {id, name, slug, locale, created_at, is_private, community_setting{...}, ...}.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges?page&per_page (max 100)&paywall_ids=product_id&created_at_gte=since (ISO 8601), newest first (default sort created_at desc): {page, per_page, has_next_page, count, page_count, records[{id, processor_id, status (paid|refunded|partial_refunded|...), refundable, amount, amount_refunded, currency, platform, payment_method_type, created_at, paywall_id, paywall_name, paywall_price_type, community_member_id, community_member_name, community_member_email}]}. `amount` is an INTEGER in currency subunits (1000 = 10.00 USD). `refunded` is not a boolean field (see status / raw.amount_refunded).

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: Circle has no separate refund object: this lists the charges with status refunded or partial_refunded (GET /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges?status=refunded,partial_refunded&page&per_page&created_at_gte=since, newest first). `id`/`sale_id` are the charge id, `amount` is amount_refunded (INTEGER in currency subunits) and `created_at` is the charge date, not the refund date; no reason is returned.

tools.name: refund
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: POST /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges/{id}/refund {amount, reason_details} refunds the charge in FULL when `amount` is omitted, or partially by `amount`, which is sent as an INTEGER in currency subunits (200 = 2.00 USD). `reason` is REQUIRED by Circle (reason_details, max 255 chars; missing → 422 upstream_error). Returns the updated charge: `amount` is amount_refunded and `status` becomes refunded or partial_refunded.
